items.title: Iran warns Israeli attacks in Lebanon threaten ceasefire with US
items.description: Earlier Israel's PM ordered strikes on Beirut's southern suburbs in response to Hezbollah rocket and drone attacks on northern Israel.

items.title: Bowen: Trump needs this war to end but Iran is not backing down
items.description: Under pressure from the polls and Gulf allies, the White House is pushing for a deal but Iran wants concessions, writes BBC's international editor.

items.title: Three Ebola vaccines in development amid growing outbreak fears
items.description: IAVI, Moderna and the University of Oxford are all working on new vaccines.

items.title: AI giant Anthropic says it plans to list on US stock market
items.description: The AI company behind Claude is set to offer the public shares of stock sometime this year.

items.title: Hungarian PM threatens to oust Orbán-era president
items.description: Hungary's president has refused Prime Minister Péter Magyar's demands to step aside, setting up a constitutional clash.

items.title: Williams, 44, to return to action in Queen's doubles
items.description: Serena Williams will return to competitive tennis for the first time in nearly four years when she plays in the women's doubles at Queen's.

items.title: Italians bemused by Milan bull mosaic restoration
items.description: Italians wondered what had happened to the animal's "lucky-charm" testicles.

items.title: US political commentators denied entry to UK by Home Office
items.description: The US citizens and left-wing content creators with huge online followings were due to speak at the SXSW London festival and Oxford this week.

items.title: France seized sanctioned Russian oil tanker with UK help, Macron says
items.description: A British helicopter provided support during the operation on Sunday, the UK ministry of defence says.

items.title: Huge blast kills dozens in rebel-held village in Myanmar
items.description: Insurgents say it was caused by explosives being used for mining close to the Chinese border.

items.title: Voting suspended in parts of Ethiopia over security concerns
items.description: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's party is expected to dominate the election as conflicts overshadow the vote.

items.title: Poland's controversial 'Highway to Hel' 666 bus revived
items.description: Poland's seaside resort called Hel is getting its 666 bus service back, despite earlier opposition from Christian groups.
